Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 3｜ Power 11000｜ Shield
[AUTO](VC):At the beginning of your ride phase, choose up to one card from your opponent's drop, your opponent calls that card to (RC), and at the end of that turn, retires that unit.

(This card cannot be in your main deck)
[Stride]-Stride Step-[COST][Discard a grade 3 card with "Demon Stealth Dragon, Shiranui" in its card name from hand], and [Stride] this card on your (VC) from face down. (When you stride, your original vanguard becomes a heart card, and this unit gets that card's [Power] and card name. At the end of the turn, return this unit face up)
Dominate -[ACT](VC)[1/turn][Generation Break 2]:[COST][Soul-Blast 1], choose one of your opponent's rear-guards, [Stand] and dominate it, and it attacks your opponent's vanguard. At the end of that battle, [Stand] and dominate all of your opponent's vanguards, and they attack your opponent's rear-guard. (Once one of the battles ends, the next battle begins. Perform drive checks with your own deck)
